record.body: Signature field protocols are designed rules for recording Signature sounds: a metadata log naming date, time, location, weather, habitat, equipment, and settings for every take, a windshield rule, a silence rule during takes, and a repeated-schedule rule so samples are comparable. The protocols are inventions modeled on real field practice, and they exist to make the fictional dataset consistent, not to describe any real expedition. The log covers all three Signature layers: the calling types for biophony, the designed weather for geophony, and the designed human sounds for anthrophony, each logged separately.
